text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Brightway asked for a 90d pin extension for their model because they're mid-migration. Can we discuss a formal lane for multi-week migrations + incentive credits? cc @Sanjay @Olivia
Sanjay: Which exact model variant are they pinned to and what's the regression signal? Need numbers to size the runway.
Maya: They're on rwd-13b-v2 (pinned). Usage ~120QPS. Canary showed ~6% semantic regression on our customer eval suite and p95 latency increased ~8ms in eu-west. Customer says rollout blockers are latency spikes in their EU region.
Olivia: 6% is above our usual accept threshold (we use 3% for critical customers). Also want to confirm embedding vector drift — often the silent breaker.
Liam: Proposal: create a "long-migration" lane with explicit artifacts: TTL tiers (30/60/90d), staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%), mandatory weekly eval snapshots, and a migration credit band (e.g., 10/20/20% discounts matching TTL). We can automate the canary via infra.
Alex: From CS — Brightway would take 60d if we offer 20% credit on committed capacity for the first 30d. They want a guaranteed rollback window and status reporting.
Sanjay: For ops we need clear automated rollback hooks + perf SLIs. If we let TTL be 90d, we should enforce a preflight checklist that gates each canary bump.
Sanjay: Preflight checklist (draft):
```text
- preflight eval run on seeded prompt set (golden answers)
- perf smoke: p50/p95 vs baseline (thresholds configured)
- KV-cache warm / cold-start simulation
- model-variant fallback configured (and tested)
- embedding schema compatibility check
```
Olivia: Add: output schema/eval for structured responses (we saw subtle JSON field reorder regressions last quarter). Also include an embedding similarity baseline test.
Maya: Action items: (1) define lane + bench exit gates, (2) define TTL options & incentive bands, (3) infra checklist to automate weekly evals and canary gating, (4) customer comms template + rollback legal blurb. Who owns the doc?
Liam: I'll draft the lane spec + sample SLOs and an ops playbook for canary gating. Assign to me.
Sanjay: I'll pair on preflight automation and add the rollback webhooks to the canary job. Ping when draft is ready.
Maya: Assigning Liam + Sanjay. Target: draft by EOW Thu. Please note Brightway deadline is 2 weeks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
oncall-bot: FYI — no on-call impact expected for canary traffic under 5% of a dedicated pool.
Alex: I'll confirm with Brightway if 60d + 20% credit is acceptable or if they insist on 90d. Will update here.
Maya: Also flag Finance/legal if credits >15% so we can get pre-approval.
Olivia: I'll run a quick cost delta for the 30/60/90 options and share numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks — let's keep comms tight. We'll review the draft in product sync tomorrow. :rocket:
